name: MKT_RM_RULE_CONDITIONS
description: This table stores the details of the conditions that make up the rule.

columns.name: RULE_CONDITION_ID
columns.description: Rule Condition Id. Primary key of the rule conditions table.

columns.name: RULE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Rule Header Id. Reference to the rule header to which the condition belongs.

columns.name: PARENT_RULE_CONDITION_ID
columns.description: Parent Rule Condition Id. Stores reference to the parent rule condition in case of a sub condition.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Sequence Number. Stores the sequence number assigned to the parent rule conditions for ordering purpose.

columns.name: PREV_RULE_CONDITION_ID
columns.description: Previous Rule Condition Id. Stores reference to the previous rule sub condition for a given sub condition.

columns.name: AGGREGATE_CONDITION_FLAG
columns.description: Aggregate Condition Flag. Indicates whether the current condition is an aggregate condition.

columns.name: AGGREGATE_OPERATOR
columns.description: Aggregate Operator. Stores the operator for the aggregate condition (Exists, Not exists, Count)

columns.name: LHS_FACT_TYPE
columns.description: LHS Fact Type. Stores type of the fact (profile) used for rule condition

columns.name: LHS_ATTRIBUTE
columns.description: LHS Attribute. Stores the attribute name of the left hand side attribute in a condition.

columns.name: OPERATOR
columns.description: Operator. Stores the operator used in a condition relating the left and right hand sides.

columns.name: CONNECTOR
columns.description: Connector. Stores the connector used between different rule conditions e.g AND, OR .

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
